name: The Mind's Decay
source:
Follow the latest case of Private Detective John Pliskin, as he is set upon an ominous path and tries to uncover a sinister plot of the local crime family. But he soon finds out; that the darkest secrets often lie deep within ourselves.

[From [url=https://isaacchambers.itch.io/the-minds-decay]Itch.io[/url]]
